purpose: Publication and visualization-only figure case selection; no model selection or accuracy claim

feature_definitions.source_power_heterogeneity: population std(source_power_W) / mean(source_power_W) over q blocks
feature_definitions.material_conductivity_heterogeneity: control-volume-weighted population SD of log10((kx*ky*kz)^(1/3)) over case-definition k regions

selection_rules.candidate_pool: all cases with the requested split role in the frozen split manifest
selection_rules.typical_median: minimize normalized L1 distance to candidate-pool medians across all seven input-only features; each feature is min-max normalized within the candidate pool; ties resolve by ascending sample_id
selection_rules.high_power: maximize package_total_power_W; ties resolve by ascending sample_id
selection_rules.strong_material_or_high_htc: maximize material_conductivity_heterogeneity; ties resolve by larger top_h_W_m2K and then ascending sample_id
selection_rules.failure_case_diagnostic: optional frozen historical valid case v6p1if1_0003; label as Therm-FM tail-error diagnostic, never representative

slice_rule.source_layer: aggregate input q-region control_volume_count by physical layer; choose the layer with the largest source footprint; ties choose the lower physical layer index
slice_rule.z_index: choose the central grid plane of the selected source layer; the same z index is used for reference, Heat3D U-v2 and Therm-FM

color_policy.temperature: Tmin/Tmax are min/max of the reference slice for that case; shared by reference and both predictions; prediction values remain unmodified and color clipping is disclosed with extend
color_policy.error: freeze Emax=max(5.0 K, pooled 99th percentile of absolute errors from both models on that case's displayed slice); one symmetric +/-Emax scale per case
color_policy.normalization: no per-model normalization, smoothing, interpolation or rescaling for full-field panels

native1024_policy.primary: native-point scatter/field at the frozen 1024 physical points
native1024_policy.supplementary: any dense image is labelled interpolated diagnostic and records interpolation method and extrapolated fraction
